# Cardputer ADV + WeAct USB Display

> Open-source C++ library, Arduino demo, and factory firmware for controlling a WeAct Display FS V1 0.96-inch USB-C panel from an M5Stack Cardputer ADV.

Canonical page (planned GitHub Pages project URL):
https://XxYouDeaDPunKxX.github.io/cardputer-adv-weact-usb-display/

Repository:
https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/cardputer-adv-weact-usb-display

## Verified scope and cautions

- Host: M5Stack Cardputer ADV, ESP32-S3, 8 MiB flash.
- Panel: WeAct Display FS V1 0.96-inch USB-C, observed firmware V1.0.0.0.
- Protocol: USB CDC; observed VID:PID 1A86:FE0C.
- Pixels: RGB565; 160x80 landscape and 80x160 portrait.
- The project has not validated other Cardputer models, larger WeAct panels, or other panel firmware revisions.
- Flashing the complete factory image at address 0x0 overwrites the entire 8 MiB flash, including settings. Read the flash guide first.
- Motion and timing measurements influence artistic animation; this is not a CPU-load visualization.

- Corresponding source: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/cardputer-adv-weact-usb-display/blob/main/sources/README.md

This is an independent project, unaffiliated with M5Stack or WeAct Studio. The repository is authoritative for code, hashes, build procedure, and validation details.
